revision_requirements: Keep the union of selected IDs and DEPLOY action IDs at most 10.

Ensure every blocker has living replacement coverage or the assigned target is actually dead before release.
Repair medical targeting and survival around artillery rather than assuming declared coverage is sufficient.
Provide enough sustained damage for artillery, mixed-pressure #21/#22, and armored #34, while keeping clearance and both protected targets.
Recompute all timing windows if movement, blocking, or roadblock clearance changes; old leak/death frames are conditional evidence only.
